name: Vyanet Albany

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story commercial building with a flat and low-slope roof|Solar panels are installed on portions of the roof|A paved parking lot is located in front of the building and holds multiple vehicles|Landscaped plantings and trees surround the structure|Sidewalks and marked parking spaces are present.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows a gray commercial building with a covered entry area|A paved parking lot extends in front of the structure with multiple vehicles parked|Landscaped trees and plantings are present along the front and sides|Sidewalks provide pedestrian access.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the gray commercial building|Portions of the paved parking lot and landscaped areas are visible|Trees and open ground border this side of the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevation of the commercial building|Landscaped plantings and trees are present along the rear perimeter|Portions of the parking lot and roof equipment are visible.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the gray commercial building with landscaped plantings|Portions of the paved parking lot and multiple vehicles are visible|Sidewalks and open ground continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved parking lot that leads from the street to the front of the building. The parking lot provides open space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the lot. Landscaped plantings and trees border the building but do not fully obstruct access. Sidewalks support pedestrian movement around the front of the facility. Neighboring commercial and open land areas are present.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking lot, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use of any secondary structures or outdoor storage areas on the property?
